nodes.description: Public total token supply declared in ERC20Basic; written in NIGIZ constructor and incremented in mint.
Mapping(address => uint256) of token balances in BasicToken; mutated by transfer, transferFrom, mint and the NIGIZ constructor.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) of allowances in StandardToken; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Public address owner of the Ownable contract; set from msg.sender in the constructor and changed by transferOwnership.
Boolean flag in TheLiquidToken that permanently disables minting once finishMinting is called.
Public uint256 initial supply of NIGIZ set to 7777777000000000000000000 in the constructor.
SafeMath.add: computes c = a + b and asserts c >= a to guard against overflow.
SafeMath.sub: asserts b <= a and returns a - b, guarding underflow.
SafeMath.mul: computes c = a * b and asserts a == 0 || c / a == b to guard overflow.
SafeMath.div: returns a / b; Solidity reverts automatically on division by zero.
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): subtracts value from msg.sender balance and adds to _to using SafeMath, then emits Transfer.
balanceOf(address _owner) constant returns the balance of _owner.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): moves balances and reduces the caller allowance stored in allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): requires zero-current-allowance or zero value, then sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
Ownable constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the deployer privileged control.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner; requires newOwner != address(0) and reassigns owner.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) enforcing owner-restricted execution.
mint(address _to, uint256 _amount) guarded by onlyOwner and canMint; increases totalSupply and balances[_to].
finishMinting() guarded by onlyOwner; sets mintingFinished = true and emits MintFinished.
canMint modifier: require(!mintingFinished) gating the mint function.
NIGIZ constructor: sets totalSupply and initialSupply to the fixed supply and assigns the whole supply to msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, balance keys and the initial owner assignment.
Unsigned uint256 addition together with the assert(c >= a) overflow guard in SafeMath.add.
Unsigned uint256 subtraction together with the assert(b <= a) underflow guard in SafeMath.sub.
Unsigned uint256 multiplication together with the assert(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard in SafeMath.mul.
Access-control require(msg.sender == owner) inside the onlyOwner modifier; wrong owner value would grant privileged access.
Arithmetic updating totalSupply and balances[_to] inside mint via SafeMath.add; supply is owner-mintable while canMint passes.

Local result variable c used in SafeMath arithmetic helpers, compared against inputs in the assert guards.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the debited balance key and the Transfer event emitter in BasicToken.transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowed[_from][msg.sender] and the allowance decrement in StandardToken.transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key written in StandardToken.approve.
Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the deployer full privileged control.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against the stored owner in an access-control require.
NIGIZ constructor credits the entire initial supply to balances[msg.sender].
mint is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier, restricting supply creation to the owner.
finishMinting is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
mint is also gated by the canMint modifier which checks mintingFinished.
transferOwnership executes only if the onlyOwner require(msg.sender == owner) holds.
SafeMath.add performs the guarded uint256 addition represented by the overflow-check unsafe operation.
SafeMath.sub performs the guarded uint256 subtraction represented by the underflow-check unsafe operation.
SafeMath.mul performs the guarded uint256 multiplication represented by the overflow-check unsafe operation.
mint performs unchecked-from-the-caller's-perspective arithmetic adding _amount to totalSupply and balances[_to].
onlyOwner modifier contains the require(msg.sender == owner) access-control operation.
BasicToken.transfer calls balances[_to].add(_value) through SafeMath.
BasicToken.transfer calls balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) through SafeMath.
StandardToken.transferFrom calls balances[_to].add(_value) through SafeMath.
StandardToken.transferFrom calls balances[_from].sub(_value) and _allowance.sub(_value) through SafeMath.
TheLiquidToken.mint calls totalSupply.add(_amount) and balances[_to].add(_amount) through SafeMath.
mint reads and increases totalSupply, expanding the token supply.
NIGIZ constructor writes totalSupply with the fixed initial amount.
transfer reads and writes balances for msg.sender and _to.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for _from and _to.
mint reads and writes balances[_to].
balanceOf returns balances[_owner].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve reads and writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender], and the require enforces a zero-allowance reset (front-running race).
allowance returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for its authorization check.
finishMinting sets mintingFinished = true, permanently disabling privileged minting.
canMint reads mintingFinished to gate minting.
NIGIZ constructor sets initialSupply to the same fixed supply value.
_to is the credited address in BasicToken.transfer.
_value is the amount subtracted from the sender and added to the recipient in transfer.
_from is the debited address and allowance owner key in transferFrom.
_to is the credited address in transferFrom.
_value is the amount moved and subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance target key in approve.
_value is the allowance amount stored and race-condition checked in approve.
newOwner is validated and becomes the new privileged owner in transferOwnership.
_to is the credited address in mint.
_amount is added to totalSupply and balances[_to] in mint.
_allowance is read from allowed and reduced by _value inside transferFrom.
Local result c is computed and compared in the SafeMath.add overflow assertion.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a temporary parameter only meaningful within BasicToken.transfer; it should be folded into the transfer function node.
_value is a temporary amount parameter consumed solely by BasicToken.transfer arithmetic.
_from is a temporary parameter used only to index balances and allowed inside transferFrom.
_to is a temporary parameter used only to credit balances inside transferFrom.
_value is a temporary amount parameter consumed by the transferFrom balance and allowance updates.
_spender is a temporary parameter used only as an allowance mapping key inside approve.
_value is a temporary allowance parameter consumed only by approve.
newOwner is a temporary parameter validated and stored only within transferOwnership.
_to is a temporary recipient parameter used only to credit balances inside mint.
_amount is a temporary supply parameter consumed by the mint arithmetic.
_allowance is a local cache of allowed[_from][msg.sender] whose lifetime is limited to transferFrom.
Local result c exists only as the temporary sum compared inside the SafeMath.add overflow guard.
